name: Kiyokawa Asumi
source:
Homeroom teacher of Yukito's class.
Still new to teaching, she has a serious yet timid personality that makes her work difficult for her.
[spoiler]Because of this, she is easily influenced by Mamiya's insanity and becomes one of his followers.[/spoiler]
translation:
Homeroom teacher of Yukito's class.
